model_equations: i a_z + a_tt/2 + (|a|^2+|b|^2) a = 0; i b_z + i delta b_t + b_tt/2 + (|a|^2 + C22 |b|^2) b = 0 (normalized soliton units)
launch: a = sqrt(p1/Sigma) sech(tau), b = sqrt(p2/Sigma) sech(tau), p1 = 1 - p2, Sigma = p1^2 + 2 p1 p2 + C22 p2^2
readout: N = sum_m sum_{|k|<=kmax} |A_m(Omega_k)|^2 (photon units, both modes, same hard bandpass), Omega_k = k 2pi/(40 T0); F = Var(N)/<N> from linearized vacuum noise of coherent inputs, Var(N) = sum |dN/dconj(B(0))|^2 with the discrete RK4IP adjoint

conventions.frequency_bins: solver frequency_axis is centered with a bin at Omega = 0; k = round(Omega T0/(2pi/40)), checked max |Omega - k dOmega| < 1e-9 dOmega
conventions.forward_method: RK4IP fixed step, Float64, CPU (solve_mmgnlse default)
conventions.exact_tensor: symmetric_S = false: S[1,2,2,1] = S[2,1,1,2] = 0, other two-1/two-2 elements S0/2; removes the coherent A2^2 A1^* and A1^2 A2^* terms exactly, so the solver integrates the incoherent XPM model itself; kappa = 0; dz = 5e-4 L_D
conventions.specified_tensor: symmetric_S = true: all two-1/two-2 elements S0/2; coherent FWM suppressed by kappa = Delta beta0 L_D on mode 2; dz = 0.1/kappa L_D (2 kappa dz = 0.2)

case1.description: C22 = 1, delta = 0, zeta = 2: all-mode F at p2 = 0.3 versus scalar (p2 = 0)

case5.description: zeta = 2, C22 = 1 (Manakov overlaps), p2 = 0.5, delta in {0.1, 0.2}; dF relative to the scalar p2 = 0 value at zeta = 2 (the case-2 p2 = 0 point; with b = 0 the result does not depend on C22 or delta)

case6.description: zeta = 2, C22 = 0.75, delta = 0; p2 = 0 reference is the case-2 p2 = 0 point

kappa_scan_locked_end_phase.note: kappa = m pi/2 so that 2 kappa zeta = 0 mod 2pi at zeta = 2

end_phase_scan_kappa_1000_plus_j_pi_over.note: j shifts the end phase 2 kappa zeta by j pi/2; the four-phase mean is the secular part of F - F_exact at kappa = 1e3, the amplitude the end-phase part
